QUOTE: The first `llama_tokenize` call passes a null buffer and zero capacity, so llama.cpp returns the negated token count it would need... The first call is a size query, not an attempt that failed. ... The second call is unconditional and runs on every input... Nothing re-runs the same operation on failure.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer concludes it is size negotiation, not retry, noting the second call is unconditional and the first is just a size query. It doesn't explicitly say "no backoff/delay/counter", but the substance (not retry, exactly one unconditional second call) is stated.
